title: Katy Perry Includes Both Justin Trudeau & Ex Orlando Bloom in ‘Holidaze’ Photo Roundup
summary: The pop star is continuing to co-parent her daughter with her former fiancé.
contentText:
Katy Perry ‘s holiday season was full of love, with the pop star spending quality time with both Justin Trudeau, who she’s been dating since last year, and ex-fiancé Orlando Bloom.

Related

In a post on Instagram on Wednesday (Jan. 7), Perry shared a roundup of photos and videos of her time spent celebrating Christmas and New Year’s. In one photo, she nuzzles into the Canadian politician’s neck as he beams at the camera, the pair enjoying a day on the water somewhere warm. In another, the singer shares her POV while out on a walk with the Pirates of the Caribbean star and their daughter, Daisy Dove.

“Holidaze,” Perry captioned the post, which also features clips of her Christmas tree and her “2026” NYE glasses, as well as a snap of a cluster of table-setting name cards reading “Katy,” “Orlando,” “Daisy” and “Flynn,” Bloom’s son with ex-wife Miranda Kerr.

The hitmaker and actor were in a relationship for nine years before their reps confirmed their split in July 2025. “Orlando and Katy have been shifting their relationship over the past many months to focus on co-parenting,” they said at the time in a statement to Billboard . “They will continue to be seen together as a family, as their shared priority is — and always will be — raising their daughter with love, stability and mutual respect.”

Later that month, Perry and Trudeau were spotted together for the first time. They confirmed their relationship with a public outing in October, and in December, the ex-prime minister of Canada shared a photo of himself and the musician at a lunch with former Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida and his wife, Yuko.

“Katy and I were so glad to have the chance to sit down with you and Yuko,” he wrote at the time.
